priorityList: Cast Bladestorm while the Colossus Smash debuff is active on the target.
Cast Champion's Spear while Colossus Smash or Avatar is active.
Cast Ravager when Colossus Smash is about to come off cooldown.
Cast Mortal Strike on cooldown during the normal rotation.
In Execute phase (target below 20% health, or 35% if talented into Massacre), use Mortal Strike only if Colossus Smash is active or you have 2 stacks of Executioner's Precision.
Use Execute whenever Sudden Death procs.
In Execute phase, cast Execute as your primary spender when you have more than 40 Rage.
Use Overpower when Opportunist procs or to generate Rage and buff your next Mortal Strike.
Maintain the Rend DoT if it has 5 seconds or less remaining on its duration.
Use Slam as a low-priority filler when you have excess Rage and other core abilities are on cooldown.
Use Wrecking Throw as a filler if no other combat abilities are available.
Use Pummel to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Sync on-use trinkets and offensive racials (like Blood Fury or Berserking) with Avatar and Colossus Smash windows.
